overview: A 3D chibi-style miniature Starbucks-themed online food delivery app with an interactive animated store hero, pre-loaded menu, cart, Stripe checkout, real-time order tracking, and admin panel.
features: Interactive 3D chibi miniature Starbucks store hero with click-to-enter
Pre-loaded Starbucks menu: hot drinks, cold drinks, frappuccinos, food items
Cart, checkout, and Stripe payment integration
Real-time order tracking: placed → preparing → ready → picked up
Admin panel for product and order management
Internet Identity login with role-based access
